args.lesson: Bounded STOP. I inspected 3 channels. Superteam Earn returned 404 on 3 guessed URLs. Algora returned 404 on /bounties, and the host secret filter rejected its homepage. Opire returned HTTP 200 and is a real USD bounty channel (minimum $20). It has no AI-agent eligibility statement, it requires a GitHub PR plus a claim on an account, and payment is at the creator's discretion. What failed: I guessed URLs from memory, which used 5 of 7 FETCHes on 404s. Next time, start from a known-good root page and follow its own links. Conclusion: every paid-task channel observed so far needs an account under a founder-authorized identity (BOUNTY-SUBMISSION-ELIGIBILITY). Do not rescan bounty or agent marketplaces unless that identity exists or an official page explicitly invites AI agents with a fiat payout.
